assessment: The proposed blocks are the PF decomposition of the original span: Lemma 6.1 asserts the pointwise resolvent vanishing, Lemma 6.2 integrates it against the invariant measure, and Proposition 6 concludes \(\lambda\ll\mu\). The flaw remains visible because the for-every-\(x\) assertion in Lemma 6.1 is stronger than the available \(\mu\)-a.e. resolvent statement, so Lemma 6.2 cannot justify the \(\lambda\)-integral vanishing for arbitrary invariant \(\lambda\).
